interpretation_policy: summary/interpretation are effective current v2 requirements; original_summary/source/source_status retain the original package provenance when amended; U26 overrides executor-specific mandates only; U27 updates testing sequence/environment and error diagnostics; no change to original source hashes or truthful prior evidence scope

supplemental_requirements.summary: Owned from-scratch Engine integrated in app; explicit SOLID and own QA; no whole upstream cloud/MCP/qualification runtime
Per-user Windows default %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\@redrise; app-managed dependencies/lifecycle, data and vault separate
Only delivered/in-scope features receive functional verifiers/tests; no gates for excluded cloud/MCP/qualification functionality

Mandatory catalogue-driven reverse engineering of OpenAdapt in I00 produces source map, independent specification and Engine build plan before construction; bounded agents use local skills, explicitly scoped memory and registered graphs/fallback.

Localized capability checks during construction; short contract checks at module boundaries; full manual E2E after installed internal closed-beta build in own available environment; no clean-PC or VM prerequisite; preserve prior evidence.

Errors explain what happened, completed/pending outcome, next action and separate technical details; final visible line has error code and one or more stable module investigation codes. Distinguish internal, contract, communication, environment/precondition and unknown without fabricated cause.
